notes: No exact v4.0.0 to Hermes v0.23.1 certification found in tagged README or release notes.
Tagged README lists /api/sessions, /api/sessions/{id}/messages and /v1/chat/completions; Hermes v0.23.1 contains these routes.
Dashboard features require separately configured dashboard authentication and connectivity.
Experimental turn_recovery v2 is not assumed available on stock Hermes.
Build, login, session creation, streaming, cancellation, model selection and file delivery still require verification.
